{{Quote|Ten years ago, the colony was attacked by the Sith. My family was killed. They never fought back. The Sith crushed them, the way you might step on a bug.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
The '''mother''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic soldier|soldier]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Holonet" /> who lived in a [[Chagrian colony|colony]]<ref name="Holonet" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> A strong pacifist<ref name="Passive Resistance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}</ref> like many of their [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the woman and a [[Fideltin Rusk's father|Chagrian male]] had a son they named Fideltin<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> by [[3680 BBY]].<ref name="Date 2">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' gives [[Fideltin Rusk]] an age of 40 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, and dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' to [[3640 BBY]].</ref>

However, Rusk rebelled against the colony's pacifist ideals<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk}}</ref> and enlisted in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as soon as he was of age, and did not return to the colony throughout the Great Galactic War and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> In [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Sith Empire [[Attack on Mindor|attacked]] the colony during an incursion into Republic space, and his mother and father were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with the rest of the colony. In the aftermath of the attack, Rusk's superiors began receiving reports that he became increasingly reckless in battle.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mother of Fideltin Rusk, a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', was first mentioned in [[the Holonet]] section of the game's official site.<ref name="Holonet" />
